text:
Jordan: Heads up — I'm rolling a Terraform change to add rotation annotations to ExternalSecrets templates. Goal: automated scheduled rotation for DB creds managed in Vault. Anyone oncall for secrets-controller compatibility checks?

Maya: I can check this morning. What's the plan for pacing? We shouldn't rotate all DBs at once.

Jordan: Plan is to add annotation `redwood.com/rotation-schedule: "@daily"` and `redwood.com/rotation-window: "02:00-06:00"` on ES template, plus a task that kicks `kubectl patch externalsecret ...` to trigger refresh. Terraform change is tiny:
```
resource "kubernetes_manifest" "es_template" {
  manifest = yamldecode(templatefile("es-template.yaml", {}))
  metadata = {
    annotations = {
      "redwood.com/rotation-schedule" = "@daily"
      "redwood.com/rotation-window" = "02:00-06:00"
    }
  }
}
```

Liam: A couple questions:
- Does our external-secrets operator respect custom annotations to trigger a rotation, or do we rely on `refreshInterval`?
- If we patch the ExternalSecret, will it re-request a new value from Vault or only reapply existing cached value?

Maya: ExternalSecrets (we run 0.5.x) will re-sync on resource change and can call `secretStoreRef` again, so patching works. But the Vault lease TTL matters — if Vault returns a new secret with same value it's no-op. We should ensure DB credentials are actually rotated via Vault rotation job.

Alex: Suggest we do staged rollout: add annotation to a single namespace (staging), then Dedicated DB service, verify consumers, then canary to prod subset. Also add a small Lambda (or k8s CronJob) that, on schedule, calls Vault rotate endpoint and then patches the ExternalSecret to force fetch.

Jordan: Good — will open PR with terraform + k8s CronJob template. Couple more asks: add `redwood.com/rotation-owner` annotation with oncall alias; and ensure the console alert triggers if patch fails.

Jen: For DB creds we use dynamic leases (Vault DB plugin) — lease duration is 1h currently. If rotate schedule is daily, need to ensure we don't create jitter that causes early expiry. Also ensure `renew` vs `revoke` behavior is OK.

Liam: Also add `spec.refreshInterval: "5m"` for the ExternalSecret pointing to DB creds during the canary to detect failure quickly, then set back to longer interval post-rollout.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: CI job infra/rotation-templates CI passed — all checks green :white_check_mark:

Maya: I'll run a dry-run for the TF change and post results here. Jordan — ping me when PR is up and I'll do the canary apply.

Jordan: PR coming in ~20m. thanks all :thumbsup:
